avoid: Overly high-impact jumps during solo time
children.counts: Count out 16 beats for each center solo turn.
children.game_version: Circle Pass Solo: Children sit in a semicircle, patting knees to a fast beat; when called, a child runs to center to show their own 16-bar movement.

seniors.counts: Keep body patting on steady 1-2 counts.
seniors.seated_version: Perform Juba hand clapping and chest/lap patting while remaining seated in a semicircle.
seniors.standing_version: Stand in place from the semicircle to execute gentle body patting without downstage solo travel.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo from fast 2/4 to a moderate beat; limit arm reach during body patting.

learning_units.description: Perform Juba body percussion patting in time with fast 2/4 meter.

social_formats.description: Semicircle formation with sequential individual/couple solo turns in center stage, ending in full troupe ensemble breakdown.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Clapping and slapping against the body ('patting Juba').
movement_profile.footwork: Elaborate solo dance steps performed in 16-bar segments downstage.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers begin seated in an opening semicircle, move downstage to the focal point for solos, and break ranks across the stage for the finale.
movement_profile.partnering: Solo performers or partnered couples taking turns in the center.

signature_moves.description: Clapping hands and slapping the body rhythmically in time with fast 2/4 or 4/4 music.
signature_moves.name: Patting Juba

signature_moves.description: Advancing to the focal point of the semicircle to execute 16 bars of elaborate steps.
signature_moves.name: Downstage Solo

music_profile.musical_form: 16-bar solo structural blocks framed by group chorus/semicircle
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Fast dance beat in 2/4 or 4/4 accompanied by hand clapping and body slapping
music_profile.sound_description: A fast, driving 2/4 or 4/4 tempo defined by energetic body percussion, clapping, and theatrical stage song arrangements.

basic_steps: Stand from semicircle formation upon musical cue
Execute Juba body-patting (clapping and slapping body in 2/4 or 4/4 time)
Advance downstage to center point of the semicircle
Perform elaborate solo dance steps for 16 bars
Retreat back to semicircle while next soloist steps downstage
Break ranks with entire troupe to dance ensemble section
teaching.formation: Semicircle with downstage center solo space
teaching.level_notes: Requires strong rhythmic coordination for Juba body patting and improvisational stage movement for solo center display.
